get_stock_exrights.return_shape: None or pandas.DataFrame indexed by date with columns [allotted_ps, rationed_ps, rationed_px, bonus_ps, exer_forward_a, exer_forward_b, exer_backward_a, exer_backward_b]
notes: date uses YYYYmmdd when supplied. date parameter is required for portable usage. Omitting date is valid only in local/QuantStudio-only mode.
bonus_ps maps to pre-tax cash dividend per share (cash_div_before_tax)
allotted_ps maps to stock dividend per share (stk_div). Does NOT include bonus share transfers (stk_bo_rate) or capital reserve transfers (stk_co_rate).
rationed_ps/rationed_px and exer_* columns are NULL when source data is unavailable.

QuantStudio (2026-07-27, F2): stocks and ETFs are both served from the unified security metadata layer (stock_basic/etf_basic). stock_type is 'stock' or 'etf'; ETF de_listed_date is populated when delisted. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; unknown securities keep the compat empty record keyed by the caller's code.

Listing-date priority: stock_basic.list_date (stock_daily first-bar fallback is marked *_fallback and must not be claimed as formal listing-date capability); ETF list_date comes from etf_basic, filled from first etf_daily bar when missing.
Local ETF metadata support does NOT imply real PTrade ETF metadata support; PTrade runtime remains unverified.

min_commission and commission_ratio must be > 0 on the platform (IQInvalidArgument otherwise, verified 2026-09-03). Conversion absorbs constant <=0 to the expressible floor (min_commission 0.01 / commission_ratio 1e-6) and wraps dynamic expressions with max(expr, floor); local QuantStudio semantics may keep min_commission=0.

notes: PTrade documents this API as callable only from before_trading_start. DELISTING_SORTING only filters current-day data.
Daily-period PTrade backtests execute run_daily callbacks at the daily bar time; an intraday time such as 09:31 requires a minute-period backtest profile.
date uses YYYYmmdd when supplied.

exclude_bse is a QuantStudio-local extension parameter (P-D13 C1b). Conversion strips the kwarg at call sites and bakes the value into the injected _QS_EXCLUDE_BSE constant (source semantics authority).
date uses YYYYmmdd when supplied; index_code must use the PTrade index identifier accepted by the target deployment.
PIT contract (2026-07-27, F3): explicit date is a strict as-of query — only the most recent complete snapshot on/before date is returned; never a history union, never a future snapshot.

When date is omitted inside a backtest, QuantStudio injects the current backtest date (never the database-global latest snapshot); outside a backtest the latest snapshot is returned (documented compat).
Empty list is returned when no snapshot exists on/before date (fail-closed); partial snapshots (constituent count far below the index maximum) are never served as complete PIT data.
Local data readiness does NOT imply PTrade platform constituent-history depth; verify coverage per deployment.
query_date uses YYYYmmdd when supplied. DELISTING_SORTING belongs to filter_stock_by_status and is not a public get_stock_status query_type.

get_industry.replacement_for: PTrade only provides get_industry_stocks(code) (industry code -> constituent stock list). Local get_industry(code) returns the stock's own industry membership. Semantics differ in direction; there is NO direct PTrade equivalent. Dual-target code must rebuild the logic with get_industry_stocks, or degrade to LOCAL_ONLY.
get_industry.return_shape: {'sw_l1': {'industry_code': str, 'industry_name': str, 'classification_system': str, 'classification_version': str}} or None
notes: Registered 2026-07-27 (F4); signature/shape corrected 2026-07-27 review to the exact local runnable subset: get_industry(code) with a single positional (or code= keyword), returning the direct sw_l1 dict (NOT keyed by security) or None.

QuantStudio serves sw_l1 from formal SW2021 PIT tables (industry_classification + industry_membership), strictly as-of the current backtest date; no valid membership -> None; never falls back to the latest industry or the legacy sw_industry snapshot.

Real-PTrade shape (security-keyed dict, date keyword, platform classification version) is NOT verified; dual-target designs must not assume {security: ...} wrapping or a date kwarg, and must record PTRADE_RUNTIME_UNVERIFIED.
Strategies depending on historical industry membership without industry_membership PIT coverage must be DATA_BLOCKED at R1.
Downgraded to LOCAL_ONLY on 2026-07-30 per AGENTS.md 铁律#4 user ruling: PTrade 官方文档无独立 get_industry，仅 get_industry_stocks。

portable_rules: Generated backtest signal-price calls must use the literal fq='pre'; missing, dynamic, dypre, post-adjusted, and attribute_history price paths are blocked.

A field extracted from get_history(..., is_dict=True) must be normalized with np.asarray(...) before numerical use. Do not unconditionally use .values, .iloc, .loc, .to_numpy(), .columns, .index or .empty on a per-security history item or extracted field.
PTrade does not inject numpy/pandas aliases. If source uses np/pd/numpy/pandas, it must explicitly import the corresponding module.
Use numpy/pandas or locally defined helpers for indicators unless the PTrade public API explicitly supplies the function.
Backtest code must not call get_snapshot or check_limit; those are trading-context APIs. get_open_orders is available in backtest and trade contexts.

current_price / get_current_data are QuantStudio-local extensions, NOT real PTrade APIs (verified 2026-08-22: module-level NameError on real platform). Dual-target/PTrade code must obtain current price from data[code].price, get_history latest bar, or get_price; validator BLOCKS these names for dual-target profiles (PTRADE-DESIGN-LOCAL-API).
Use get_stock_info(..., field=['listed_date']) for listing dates.
For a confirmed current completed minute bar, use get_history(..., frequency='1m', include=True) only inside the scheduled minute callback and document the cutoff.
Date arguments passed to PTrade APIs should be normalized to YYYYmmdd strings unless the platform documents a date object.
Treat order/order_target_value return values as opaque order IDs or None; do not rely on QuantStudio-local result.status attributes. Use get_order/get_open_orders and portfolio reconciliation.
Call filter_stock_by_status only from before_trading_start. Use get_stock_status for status checks required by scheduled callbacks.

validation_policy.all_profiled_calls: validate allowed keyword names and positional limits for every profiled API
validation_policy.dynamic_kwargs: BLOCK because exact broker compatibility cannot be proven
validation_policy.local_adapter_rule: do not accept undocumented aliases through **kwargs
validation_policy.unprofiled_top_level_calls: BLOCK every external top-level call in dual/PTrade source unless it is a Python builtin, imported/local function, or registered in signatures.
validation_policy.required_api_profile: BLOCK a dual/PTrade design when components.required_apis contains an API absent from signatures (except the log object).

runtime_corrections.get_open_orders: PTrade public documentation marks get_open_orders(security=None) available in backtest and trade; profile 1.2.0 incorrectly blocked it.
runtime_corrections.set_backtest_is_trade: Runtime traceback supplied on 2026-07-25 (platform timestamp 2026-07-26) proves set_backtest/is_trade are QuantStudio-local extensions, not PTrade backtest public APIs.
runtime_corrections.log_warn: Runtime traceback supplied on 2026-07-25 (platform timestamp 2026-07-26) proves IQEngine LogEngine has no warn attribute; generated PTrade source must use log.warning.
runtime_corrections.numpy_pandas_injection: Real IQEngine log supplied on 2026-07-25 shows 79 occurrences of NameError for np; PTrade does not inject QuantStudio-local np/pd aliases. Portable source must import numpy/pandas explicitly when used.
runtime_corrections.core_stock_api_profile: Profile 1.7.0 registers set_benchmark, run_daily, get_Ashares, get_index_stocks, get_stock_status, get_positions, get_position, get_trade_days, and get_fundamentals; unprofiled injected calls now fail closed.
runtime_corrections.get_stock_status_delisting: PTrade get_stock_status uses query_type=DELISTING. DELISTING_SORTING is a filter_stock_by_status filter type, not a get_stock_status query type.
runtime_corrections.get_history_return_shape: Profile 1.8.0 records the get_history(..., is_dict=True) return contract: mapping items may be pandas.DataFrame, numpy.structured_array or numpy.recarray; item[field] may be a pandas.Series or numpy.ndarray. Generated code must normalize fields with np.asarray before numerical use; unguarded pandas-only attribute access (.values/.iloc/.loc/.to_numpy()/.columns/.index/.empty) on history items is blocked by the validator.

blocked_aliases.warn: Use log.warning(...); the real IQEngine LogEngine does not expose log.warn(...).
